mn141:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā. Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane migadāye.
mn141:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn141:2.1: Tathāgatena, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena va Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, yadidaṃ
mn141:2.2: catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ ācikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ.
mn141:3.1: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa ācikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ. Dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa ācikkhanā . . . uttānīkammaṃ. Dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa . . . uttānīkammaṃ. Dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa . . . uttānīkammaṃ.
mn141:4.1: Tathāgatena, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā . . . kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, yadidaṃ
mn141:5.6: Sāriputto, bhikkhave, sotāpattiphale vineti, Moggallāno uttamatthe;
mn141:5.7: Sāriputto, bhikkhave, pahoti cattāri ariyasaccāni vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātun ti.
mn141:6.2: idaṃ vutvā Sugato uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
mn141:7.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto acirapakkantassa Bhagavato bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn141:7.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
mn141:8.1: Tathāgatena, āvuso, arahatā sammāsambuddhena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ . . .
mn141:9.1: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa ācikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaranā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ.
mn141:10.2: Jāti pi dukkhā, jarā pi dukkhā, maraṇam pi dukkhaṃ, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā pi dukkhā. Yam p' icchaṃ na labhati, tam pi dukkhaṃ; saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
mn141:11.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti, nibbati abhinibbatti, khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho; --
mn141:12.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhānī indriyānaṃ paripāko;
mn141:13.2: Yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā, bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā, khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷebarassa nikkhepo;--
mn141:14.2: Yo kho, āvuso, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ, antosoko antoparisoko;--
mn141:15.2: Yo kho, āvuso, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo, ādevanā paridevanā, ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ;--
mn141:16.2: Yaṃ kho, āvuso, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ;--
mn141:17.2: Yaṃ kho, āvuso, cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, --
mn141:18.2: Yo kho, āvuso, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso, āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ, --
mn141:19.1: Katamañ c', āvuso,yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ? --
mn141:19.2: Jātidhammānaṃ, āvuso, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati:
mn141:19.3: Aho vata mayaṃ na jātidhammā assāma, na ca vata no jāti āgaccheyyāti;
mn141:19.4: na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ;
mn141:19.5: idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati, tam pi dukkhaṃ.
mn141:19.10: Aho vata mayaṃ na sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsādhammā assāma, na ca vata no sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā āgaccheyyun ti;
mn141:19.11: na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ;
mn141:19.12: idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ.
mn141:20.1: Katame c', āvuso, saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā? --
mn141:20.2: Seyyathīdaṃ: rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṃkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇūpādānakkhandho;--
mn141:20.3: ime vuccant', āvuso, saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
mn141:21.2: Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn141:22.2: Yo tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo;--
mn141:23.1: Katamañ c', āvuso, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccam? --
mn141:23.2: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn141:23.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammā-ājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
mn141:24.2: Yaṃ kho, āvuso, dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya nāṇaṃ;--
mn141:26.2: Musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī;--
mn141:27.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnadānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī;--
mn141:28.2: Idh', āvuso, ariyasāvako micchā-ājīvaṃ pahāya sammā-ājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti;--
mn141:29.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn141:29.3: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti . . . padahati;
mn141:29.4: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti . . . padahati;
mn141:29.5: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammohāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti . . . padahati;--
mn141:30.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
mn141:31.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn141:31.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pitisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ
mn141:31.7: Idaṃ vuccat', āvuso, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
mn141:32.1: Tathāgaten', āvuso, arahatā sammāsambuddhena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, yadidaṃ
mn141:32.2: imesaṃ catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ acikkhanā desanā paññāpanā paṭṭhapanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkamman ti. Idam
mn141:32.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
